name: Parovozik v Kachalkovo
source:
In war-torn 1990s Russia, Rico flees to a remote village after a gang murders his family. But in Kachalkovo, something far darker awaits.

[From [url=https://kaskad-games.itch.io/pvk]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
20世纪90年代，俄罗斯饱受战争蹂躏，里科的家人遭到帮派杀害，他逃到了一个偏远的村庄。但在卡查尔科沃，更黑暗的事情正在等待着。

[来自[url=https://kaskad-games.itch.io/pvk]Itch.io[/url]]
